clue.text: Male with a zip cut old wooden bowl

indicators.note: cut means the word is docked of its final letter

parts.note: zip is slang for nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A man with a trouser zip appears to be chopping up an antique wooden bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks ZERO to ZER. 'zip' means nothing at all here, not a fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A mazer is an archaic drinking vessel, a hardwood bowl often rimmed with silver.

clue.text: Artist and singer's aid — he joins film director with band of the '70s

parts.note: a mic, microphone, helps a singer
Fritz Lang directed Metropolis
ELO, Electric Light Orchestra, was a 1970s band

explanation.surface: A singer's mic, a film director and a 70s band unite, as the film world meets rock.
explanation.definitionFit: Michelangelo was the Renaissance painter and sculptor of the Sistine Chapel ceiling.

clue.text: Upset Led Zeppelin's leader taking in lover for drink

indicators.note: taking means taking another piece inside
upset in a down clue means turned upside down, read backwards
the leader of the word is its first letter

parts.note: a fan is a lover of something

explanation.surface: A Led Zeppelin frontman is put out when a girlfriend joins him for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' turns LEDZ to ZDEL in this down clue. Strictly, zinfandel is a grape, but its wine takes the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Zinfandel is a red wine grape, and the wine made from it is a drink.

clue.text: Play jam one louder, it's mad

indicators.note: mad means the letters go crazy into a new order

explanation.surface: Musicians playing a jam even louder is crazy, a Spinal Tap 'one louder' joke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one louder' echoes Spinal Tap's amp that goes to eleven, but here all the words are plain fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's tragedy of the star-crossed lovers of Verona is a famous stage play.

clue.text: Film again before breaking guitar's last string

indicators.note: breaking means one piece splits open the other and sits inside it
the guitar's last is the final letter of that word

parts.note: a cord is a piece of string
ere is a poetic word for before

explanation.surface: A musician must lay a track down again because a guitar string snapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' looks like the snapped string, but it is the insertion signal. The theme is the film This Is Spinal Tap.
explanation.definitionFit: To record a piece once more is literally to make a second recording, as for a film soundtrack.

clue.text: Call about English act making comeback

indicators.note: about means going around the other piece

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them
a turn is a performer's act

explanation.surface: A call asking an English entertainer to make a comeback.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming back is returning, so staging a comeback is returning to the stage.

clue.text: Fiddles with equipment

definitions.meaning: fiddling means tampering dishonestly, as in rigging a vote
a rig is a set of equipment, such as a band's gear

explanation.surface: Someone tinkers with gear.
explanation.definitionFit: To rig is to manipulate a result, and rigs are kits of apparatus such as oil or sound setups.

clue.text: Rubbish you picked up? Time to give up being wasted

parts.note: crap is slang for rubbish

indicators.note: picked up means heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: the letter U sounds like this word
Lent is the period when Christians give things up

explanation.surface: Someone calls you rubbish for being hammered and should give up drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Crapulent means sick from excessive drinking, while wasted is slang for very drunk.

clue.text: On it away from addiction?

parts.note: re means on, concerning

indicators.note: away from means the second piece is removed from the first

parts.note: a habit is an addiction
taken as written, the letters to be removed

explanation.surface: Someone on drugs is going clean, away from addiction.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the wordplay and also describes a stay in a clinic.
explanation.definitionFit: Rehab, short for rehabilitation, is treatment aimed at breaking a dependency.

clue.text: Filming Tap orgy in hotel — came when aroused

indicators.note: aroused means the letters are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A racy account of a band's hotel debauchery, nodding to the Spinal Tap film.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinematography is the art and craft of motion-picture photography, the work of shooting a film.

clue.text: Hearing short works after interval — organ sticking out?

indicators.note: after places the anagram behind the first word

parts.note: a hiatus is a pause, an interval

indicators.note: works signals the letters are worked into a new order
short means the last letter is cut off

explanation.surface: A short hearing of works after the interval, with an organ part sticking out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the G from HEARING; 'works' rearranges HEARIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus hernia is when part of the stomach bulges up through the diaphragm.

clue.text: In the morning love to be entertained by kinky nurse's charms

indicators.note: being entertained by something means being held inside it
kinky signals twisted letters

parts.note: the word nurse, the apostrophe-s being only a possessive link
AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone is smitten in the morning by a nurse's saucy charms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kinky' scrambles the nurse into ENURS, which then holds AMO; 'charms' is a verb here, not a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: To enamour is to fill with love, so a verb meaning bewitches or captivates fits.

clue.text: One trailing dumb group, half lost in city

indicators.note: trailing means coming behind the other pieces

parts.note: keeping mum means saying nothing, so mum is dumb

indicators.note: half of the word is dropped, keeping only its front half

parts.note: a band is a musical group
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone tags along behind a quiet band whose members have half gone missing in a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Mumbai, formerly Bombay, is India's largest city and its financial capital.

clue.text: See 3
Play? Removing top in the Sun for circulation: that's not graceful

indicators.note: being put in circulation means the letters are moved around
the top of a down entry word is its first letter, taken away

explanation.surface: A tabloid newspaper, the Sun, puts out a play story for circulation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Removing top' turns THE to HE; 'in' is a link. The Sun is a British tabloid.
explanation.definitionFit: Unshapely describes something badly formed, lacking pleasing proportions or grace.

clue.text: They abuse right to occupy band on the road?

indicators.note: to occupy means to sit inside the other piece

parts.note: a band on tour are tourers

explanation.surface: Is a touring band entitled to take over the road?
explanation.definitionFit: Torturers inflict cruel pain, the most extreme form of mistreating someone.

clue.text: Film covering record pitch

indicators.note: covering means the first piece wraps around the second

parts.note: E.T. is the Spielberg film
REC is the abbreviation marked on a recording button

explanation.surface: A movie includes a recorded sales pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch a tent is to put it up, a synonym for raising a structure.

clue.text: Delivery of European spot (one must be United)

indicators.note: must be signals one letter is swapped for another

parts.note: a location is a spot, a place
A means one, as the indefinite article
U is the abbreviation for United, as in football club names

explanation.surface: A football commentator delivers a line about a European venue and a United side.
explanation.definitionFit: Elocution is the skill of clear speaking, the manner of delivering speech.

clue.text: Takes in hype going over front of sleeve

indicators.note: going over means turning backwards here

parts.note: a plug is a promotional mention, hype

indicators.note: front of means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Promotion for a record turns up on the front of its album sleeve.
explanation.definitionFit: Gulping down drink is swallowing it, taking it in greedily.

clue.text: Turns ugly, oddly missing lots

indicators.note: the odd letters are dropped, leaving the even-placed ones

parts.note: rations are allotted lots, shares

explanation.surface: Things take an ugly turn as many items go missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Gyrations are spinning or whirling movements, rotations.

clue.text: Spinal Tap turning up current album …

indicators.note: turning signals the letters are rotated into a fresh order

explanation.surface: The band Spinal Tap boosts the volume on its latest album.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spinal Tap' looks like the band from the theme film, but it is a medical procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinal tap is the American name for drawing fluid from the lower spine with a needle.

clue.text: Month to handle on-screen director

parts.note: to handle a tool is to use it

explanation.surface: It takes a month to manage a film director.
explanation.walkthrough: 'director' suggests a film-maker, but the definition means a pointing device.
explanation.definitionFit: A computer mouse steers the pointer around the screen, so it directs things there.

clue.text: See 19
Group with good reverberation

parts.note: a clan is a family group

explanation.surface: A band with a good resonant sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A clang is a loud ringing metallic noise that resounds.

clue.text: Celebrity mag detailed suffering

indicators.note: de-tailed means its tail, the last letter, is lopped off

parts.note: Hello! is a British celebrity magazine

explanation.surface: A celebrity magazine gives a detailed account of someone's ordeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' reads as de-tailed. Hello! is a British celebrity gossip weekly.
explanation.definitionFit: Hell is a state of extreme torment or misery.

clue.text: … bank up to eleven — air's rocking

indicators.note: rocking means the letters are shaken into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Continuing the Spinal Tap scene: amplifiers cranked to eleven and the air shaking with rock.
explanation.walkthrough: In This Is Spinal Tap, the amplifiers go up to eleven, one louder than ten.
explanation.definitionFit: Superelevation is the banking of a road or railway curve, raising its outer edge.

clue.text: Uses again, touching series of songs

parts.note: re means concerning, touching on
a song cycle is a series of linked songs

explanation.surface: A musician reuses material in some moving song cycles.
explanation.definitionFit: Recycling material means putting it through use a second time.

clue.text: A car's back concealing new drugs

indicators.note: concealing means holding the other piece inside
back means the word reads backwards

parts.note: a Jag is a Jaguar car

explanation.surface: Drugs smuggled in the boot of a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns JAG to GAJ, N goes inside it, and A comes last.
explanation.definitionFit: Ganja is a slang name for cannabis, a recreational drug.
